atoms.b: Centimetres are used to measure smaller things, like the length of a ((++pen house)).
Metres are used to measure larger things, like the height of a ((++tree book)).

instruction.text: Which unit would you use to measure the object? Drag the objects to the correct measurement.

wrong.text: A pen is much shorter than 1 metre.
A book is much shorter than 1 metre.
A car is much longer than 100 centimetres.
A tree is much taller than 100 centimetres.

instruction.text: Which unit would you use to measure the object? Drag the objects to the correct measurement.

wrong.text: Glasses are much shorter than 1 metre.
A banana is much shorter than 1 metre.
A bus is much longer than 100 centimetres.
A bicycle is longer than 100 centimetres.

atoms.instruction: How long would you expect a rubber to be? Choose the most likely answer.

hint.text: A centimetre is about the width of your finger and a metre is about the length of a big step.

atoms.sound: Rubbers are usually about 5 cm long.

atoms.instruction: How long would you expect a water bottle to be? Choose the most likely answer.

hint.text: A centimetre is about the width of your finger and a metre is about the length of a big step.

atoms.sound: Water bottles are usually about 20 cm long.

instruction.text: How tall would you expect an apple tree to be? Choose the most likely answer.

hint.text: A centimetre is about the width of your finger and a metre is about the length of a big step.

atoms.sound: Apple trees are usually about 4 metres tall.

instruction.text: How long would you expect a dog to be? Choose the most likely answer.

hint.text: A centimetre is about the width of your finger and a metre is about the length of a big step.

atoms.sound: Dogs are usually about 1 metre long.
